published.name: Little Itoshin
published.description: A Japanese dining bar and takeaway at shop 6, 110 Mountain View Ave in Miami. Dinner runs Tuesday to Saturday from 5:30pm, with the kitchen closed Sunday and Monday. Beyond the regular service, the team takes enquiries for private chef bookings, functions and catering.

published.name: Balboa Italian
published.description: An Italian restaurant on the Gold Coast Highway, serving the Gold Coast since 2016. The kitchen works from local and imported produce, cooking classically Italian dishes with a modern hand: signature plates include beef cheek gnocchi and pappardelle al ragù made in house. Cocktails and wine round out the menu, in a setting the team describe as both elegant and vibrant. Open for dinner through the week, with lunch added from Friday to Sunday.

published.name: Palm's Indian Kitchen
published.description: A family-run Indian restaurant on the Gold Coast Highway at Palm Beach, open seven days. The menu moves from soups and appetisers through tandoor dishes to curries ranging from mild to spicy, served with rice and fresh-baked naan, and finishing with Indian desserts. Both vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes are covered, each made to order. The full menu is also available for pickup.
published.meritSplit: local: Generic family Indian takeaway with no distinctive dishes, chef, or room identity beyond standard menu categories.

published.name: Farmers Market
published.description:
A Saturday market held in the grounds of the Burleigh Heads State School, on the corner of Lower Gold Coast Hwy and West Burleigh Rd. It runs every Saturday from 7am to noon, rain, hail or shine, with free entry and parking on the school oval.

Stalls cover fresh farm produce, organic fruit and vegetables, gourmet and global foods, meat, fish and deli products, alongside flowers, plants, arts and crafts, antiques and collectibles. Coffee and bakery treats are always on hand. Live entertainment features local talent each week, and pre-lived rack sales run on the last Saturday of each month.

published.name: Palooka
published.description: Contemporary modern European dining in Stratford Village, Cairns. The kitchen runs a rotating set of weeknight offers: pasta with a choice of five options on Wednesdays, steak with house beer or wine on Thursdays, and a three-course bottomless lunch from Friday to Sunday. Seasonal cooking appears when it's available, including dishes built around fresh black truffle. Takeaway pizzas can also be ordered. The venue hosts events and guest pastry chefs alongside its regular service.
